name: @equstng/agent-sdk-wasm-and-nodejs-compatibility-test
description: WASM and Node.js compatibility tests of ASDK wrappers

scripts.setup:wasm: npm i $npm_package_config_wasm_path && npm run build:dev:cjs $npm_package_config_wasm_path && npm pkg set dependencies.agent-sdk=file:../../wasm/pkg && npm install
scripts.setup:nodejs: npm i $npm_package_config_nodejs_path && npm run build:debug $npm_package_config_nodejs_path && npm pkg set dependencies.agent-sdk=file:../../nodejs && npm install
